_comment_SSOT_design: This JSON config is the SSOT. ALL parameters controlled here. Snapshot provides only particle data (positions, velocities, masses, densities).
comment: Lane-Emden 3D Hydrostatic Test with Self-Gravity - ~2k particles
description: Hydrostatic equilibrium test after relaxation. User controls ALL physics and simulation parameters via this config.
_comment_snapshot: Snapshot provides particle data (pos, vel, mass, dens). All physics parameters below override snapshot metadata.
_comment_reset_time: Reset simulation time to 0 when resuming (true for fresh test, false to continue from snapshot time)
_comment_sph: Options: ssph, gsph, disph, gdisph, srgsph. Using GDISPH for stability.
_comment_order: false = 1st order (stable), true = 2nd order (more accurate but can be unstable)
_comment_kernel: Options: cubic, wendland. Wendland has compact support, better for gravity.
_comment_neighbors: Target number of neighbors for kernel support
_comment_time_av: Adaptive AV based on shock detection
_comment_theta: Barnes-Hut opening angle (lower = more accurate, slower)
_comment_output: Snapshot output interval in code units
_comment_riemann: Riemann solver for GSPH/GDISPH: hll, iterative, kitajima
_comment_expected_behavior: Density profile constant (RMS < 5%), velocities small (|v| < 1% c_s), energy conserved (drift < 1%)
